data.name: Mummy
data.description: A powerful creature of the undead.  These creatures drain your life force.

data.name: Dinosaur
data.description: A smaller dinosaur that must hunt in packs in order to bring down larger prey.

data.name: Proto-Badger
data.description: Large and heavily armored with a bony back plate and horns.  Only a fool would back one of these things into a corner.

data.name: Dinosaur
data.description: A strong family structure allows these giant reptiles to survive in a hostile environment.

data.name: Slime Demon
data.description: Completely mindless.  They are used as shock troops and as food by most other demons.

data.name: Cavalry Trooper
data.description: A hardy warrior trained for combat.  A true asset to the king.

data.name: Dinosaur
data.description: Neither very fast nor powerful. These nasty reptiles do have one advantage - a poisonous bite.

data.name: Zombie
data.description: A humanoid raised from the dead to become one of the cursed undead.

data.name: Giant Worker Ant
data.description: Over 2 feet of pure terror.

data.name: Guardian Spider
data.description: Be careful not to fall victim to its bite.  It has been known to cause paralysis.

data.name: Green Dragon
data.description: One of the weaker races of dragon kind.  A sly mind and a taste for blood make green dragons a force to be feared.

data.name: Mush Man
data.description: Humanoid in shape.  Made from a colony of semi-intelligent mosses.

data.name: Giant Bee
data.description: A paralyzing sting makes these insects as deadly as they look.

data.name: Royal Guard
data.description: Pressed into service to pay off depts, these troops are not much of a match for those skilled with weapons.

data.name: Royal Corporal
data.description: Somewhat skilled with weapons.  The preferred weapon is the bow.

data.name: Shantile
data.description: Half man.  Half fish.  All bad temper.

data.name: Podling
data.description: Though slow moving and mindless, they will do the bidding of the Mush Mound which spawned them.

data.name: Dinosaur
data.description: The creature's favorite form of attack is to lower its armored head and charge.  Don't stand in front of it when it does.

data.name: Slime
data.description: Completely mindless.  They are used as shock troops and as food by most other demons.

data.name: Krise
data.description: A small, reptilian race.  They are extremely evil and travel in large groups for they are small in stature and are often eaten as food if found alone.

data.name: Carrion Beast
data.description: Normally they feed on only the dead, but in times of hunger they will hunt their prey.  They are semi-intelligent and travel with other that feed on carrion.

data.name: Slime
data.description: They sport a nasty chemical attack.  Oh, I guess it may be worth mentioning.  They may split into two slimes when killed.

data.name: Giant Spider
data.description: A storm of claws and fangs.  Your basic garden variety of giant spider.

data.name: Goblin Champion
data.description: Above average in both skill and size.

data.name: Ghoul
data.description: A creature of the undead.  This foul creature's touch can cause disease.  They also regenerate wounds so it is best to kill them as fast as you can.

data.name: Vesp Spider
data.description: Skilled in the art of archery.

data.name: Anti'id
data.description: A strange race indeed.  Not even the oldest of elven sages know of the oragins of this foul race.  Some speculate they are not of this world.

data.name: Gnome Warrior
data.description: Quick and nimble, this hardy race is known for thier ability to find a mechanical way to achive almost any task.

data.name: Giant Snake
data.description: A poisonous bite may be the least of your worries if you meet up with one of these vermin.

data.name: Whip Scorpion
data.description: Capable of launching a multitude of attacks, this critter is extremely deadly.

data.name: Carrion Slug
data.description: Disgusting to behold, the smell of these creatures is a strong clue as to their diet.

data.name: Giant Boar
data.description: A giant boar with a bad attitude.

data.name: Skeletal Warrior
data.description: Completely mindless.  They are used as shock troops and as food by most other demons.

data.name: Royal Sergeant
data.description: Big as a thespian devil cat and twice as mean.  These men are solely paid to keep the troops in line.  They use force if necessary.

data.name: Cavalry Officer
data.description: A true leader of men.  Trusted with the task of keeping the troops in line and loyal to the king.

data.name: Giant Rat
data.description: A large filthy rat.  Its bite can cause disease.

data.name: Orc Warrior
data.description: A common orc who claims to have some skill with weapons.

data.name: Blue Dragon
data.description: Woe are the fools that find themselves in lonely company with one of this ilk.

data.name: Young Hill Giant
data.description: Young and weak when compared to a fully grown giant.  Still more than a match for any full grown human or orc.

data.name: Troll
data.description: Filthy claws can cause disease if they break the skin.

data.name: Cacodeamon Warlord
data.description: Hailing from some unknown plane, these beasts are often summoned by powerful enchanters to do their bidding.

data.name: Winged Devil
data.description: These minor devils live their lives as servants to those more powerful than themselves.

data.name: Cacodaemon Warrior
data.description: A blaze of claw and fang.  The speed of these nether world creatures is almost without compare.

data.name: Ghost
data.description: An apparition from beyond the grave.  Niether good nor evil by nature, it is still best to avoid such creatures.

data.name: Larva
data.description: A mindless larva.  Nobody knows what this thing will turn into because it has never been found in a cocoon state.

data.name: Giant Frog
data.description: A giant frog.  What else can you say?

data.name: Royal Lieutenant
data.description: A would be leader of men.  Most die in battle at the hands of thier own men if they are not careful.

data.name: Sabre Feline
data.description: A powerful cousin to the modern day mountain lion.

data.name: Gnath
data.description: Extremely strong for their size, these beasts make excellent warriors.

data.name: Mush Mound
data.description: Incapable of rapid movement, these bizzar creatures spawn podlings.  The podlings act as mindless slaves.

data.name: Demon
data.description: A small demon from the nether region.  In large numbers though they can be a difficult force to deal with.

data.name: Spectre
data.description: An apparition from beyond the grave and extremely evil by nature.  It's good pactice to stay clear of these whispy creatures.

data.name: Goblin Hero
data.description: A strong goblin warrior that has risen above those of more ordinary skill.

data.name: Rat Demi-Lord
data.description: With special attacks and the ability to summon other giant rats to aid it in battle, this mystic creature is one best left alone.

data.name: Royal Captain
data.description: An experienced leader with the respect of his troops.  Few will question his orders.

data.name: Hell Bat
data.description: Though not native to the nine planes of hell, they populate large regions of that foul area.

data.name: Flesh Fiend
data.description: Filthy claws and teeth make this creature a deadly menace.  Fear it's bite for it can paralize.

data.name: Dinosaur
data.description: Sporting a nasty bite, these critters are more dangerous than they look.

data.name: Cave Lizard
data.description: Large, slow, stupid.  Put it all together and you have a four- footed eating machine with sharp teeth.

data.name: Red Dragon
data.description: Strongest of the evil dragons.  Few are those that have met with one, and LIVED!

data.name: Hag
data.description: An old wretch with little to loose in life.

data.name: Hill Giant
data.description: Large and brutish.  These simple- minded humanoids survive due to there sheer size.

data.name: Giant Zombie
data.description: Long dead creatures of a larger race.  Many such creatures were once gnolls, bug bears, ogres or true giants.

data.name: Trigwig
data.description: A disgusting blind creature of the deep.  Four clawed feet, two tentacles and a trunk that resembles an elephants all combine to make this a creature to avoid.

data.name: Giant Wasp
data.description: Avoid the paralyzing bite of these large insects.

data.name: Mental Flea
data.description: Only slightly less primitive than a caveman.  These humanoids bear a much closer resemblance to animals than to humans.

data.name: Mercenary Villain
data.description: Abused as youngsters, these ill- tempered men are but common thugs for hire.

data.name: Beast Man
data.description: Only slightly less primitive than a caveman.  These humanoids bear a much closer resemblance to animals than to humans.

data.name: Goblin Archer
data.description: Capable with the bow and prefers to pepper its enemies from afar.

data.name: Orc Archer
data.description: Skilled in the art of archery.

data.name: Goblin
data.description: Small and weak.  Goblins band together in large tribes for their own protection.

data.name: Thief
data.description: Pickpocket, cutpurse, burglar.  By any name, a thief is a thief.

data.name: Dragon Lizard
data.description: Not a true dragon.  Named after one because it is the only beast known that can rival a dragon's brute strength.

data.name: Monstrous Rat
data.description: A common vermin of immense size.

data.name: Ogre
data.description: Standing 8 feet tall or more, these large brutes love to bully those weaker than themselves.  They are often employed as troops in mercenary armies.
